policy: Preserve all recorded bibliographic fields and enums; record unknown dates explicitly. No source access or publication dates invented.
schemaVocabularyExtensions: Existing authored values retained verbatim rather than mapped to broader categories
undatedLeadPolicy: Only explicitly undated automated imports with retained metadata may remain undated: unclassified publication/web/bibliographic leads without fitness categories, or taxonomic-database web locators with unresolved authors and taxonomy/range fitness. Curated papers require a recorded year and DOI or HTTPS source locator.
